command:
set -u
echo '--- CLIENT SHOW ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStatus -p Result -p NRestarts -p ExecStart || true
echo '--- CLIENT STATUS ---'
systemctl --user status --no-pager frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service || true
echo '--- CLIENT JOURNAL ---'
journalctl --user -u frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -n 120 --no-pager || true
echo '--- PORT 8765 ---'
ss -ltnp 'sport = :8765' || true
echo '--- CLIENT PROCESS ---'
PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$PID" ] && [ "$PID" != "0" ]; then ps -fp "$PID" || true; pstree -ap "$PID" || true; fi
echo '--- CONVERSATION SERVICE ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart || true
echo '--- ENV FILE META ---'
stat -c 'mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g size=%s path=%n' $HOME/.config/frankenstein/chatgpt-client.env 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- DEPLOYED FILE HASHES ---'
sha256sum $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_host_live_client.py $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_host_agent.py 2>/dev/null || true
